g.text: J1 receives regulated always-on 5 V DC. Pixel power uses its own external fused 5 V feed.

g.desc: J1 receives regulated always-on 5 V DC. Pixel power uses its own external fused 5 V feed.

g.text: ANIMA RPS Controller v1.2 Release | low voltage DC only | ESP32-S3 / 5 servos / 3 coils / 7 Hall stops

g.desc: ANIMA RPS Controller v1.2 Release | low voltage DC only | ESP32-S3 / 5 servos / 3 coils / 7 Hall stops

g.text: Check the exact LD2410 variant and its 3.3 V UART levels at the harness.

g.desc: Check the exact LD2410 variant and its 3.3 V UART levels at the harness.

g.text: FB senses 3V3 after L1. Check regulator thermal and switching layout in review.

g.desc: FB senses 3V3 after L1. Check regulator thermal and switching layout in review.

g.text: The Pi has independent 27 W power. Reference grounds are common at the DC star.

g.desc: The Pi has independent 27 W power. Reference grounds are common at the DC star.

g.text: Channel 1 index + middle | Channel 2 ring + little | Channel 3 thumb

g.desc: Channel 1 index + middle | Channel 2 ring + little | Channel 3 thumb

g.text: Clamp diode is across each coil output. TVS catches drain overshoot. Confirm clamp energy and release on the bench.

g.desc: Clamp diode is across each coil output. TVS catches drain overshoot. Confirm clamp energy and release on the bench.

g.text: Do not route servo motor current through this board. Confirm peak-rail current, copper thermal rise and cutoff behavior.

g.desc: Do not route servo motor current through this board. Confirm peak-rail current, copper thermal rise and cutoff behavior.

g.text: All contact inputs are normally open to ground.

g.desc: All contact inputs are normally open to ground.

g.text: Controller starts disarmed and must receive a deliberate reset after a stop.

g.desc: Controller starts disarmed and must receive a deliberate reset after a stop.

g.text: Send the same mono sample on both audio channels. GAIN is intentionally open.

g.desc: Send the same mono sample on both audio channels. GAIN is intentionally open.

g.text: J5 carries logic only. The external DC disconnect interrupts motor power independently.

g.desc: J5 carries logic only. The external DC disconnect interrupts motor power independently.

g.text: OE is hardware-inhibited. TTL inputs and 5 V logic outputs suit the PWM loom.

g.desc: OE is hardware-inhibited. TTL inputs and 5 V logic outputs suit the PWM loom.

g.text: Input is downstream of the external DC cutoff. Do not drive coils until an actual pulse/thermal profile is validated.

g.desc: Input is downstream of the external DC cutoff. Do not drive coils until an actual pulse/thermal profile is validated.

g.text: A maintained external DC disconnect interrupts coil and servo motor power.

g.desc: A maintained external DC disconnect interrupts coil and servo motor power.

g.text: Pi host UART 3.3 V only. Disconnect Pi UART when using the programming header.

g.desc: Pi host UART 3.3 V only. Disconnect Pi UART when using the programming header.

g.text: Aux contact closes in healthy state. Missing contact or ARM_REQ low holds RUN_N high.

g.desc: Aux contact closes in healthy state. Missing contact or ARM_REQ low holds RUN_N high.

g.text: Each DRV5033 gets local bypass at its remote sensor. Pair signal with ground throughout.

g.desc: Each DRV5033 gets local bypass at its remote sensor. Pair signal with ground throughout.

g.text: IO19 senses the interlock. Native USB D-/D+ are unavailable.

g.desc: IO19 senses the interlock. Native USB D-/D+ are unavailable.

g.text: Signal headers carry PWM and return only. Motor power reaches servos through the separate fused 6 V loom.

g.desc: Signal headers carry PWM and return only. Motor power reaches servos through the separate fused 6 V loom.

g.text: The external pixel supply must be current-limited to its verified panel draw.

g.desc: The external pixel supply must be current-limited to its verified panel draw.

g.text: Use 10 kOhm NTCs with known Beta. Treat open or short circuits as faults.

g.desc: Use 10 kOhm NTCs with known Beta. Treat open or short circuits as faults.

g.text: Seven open-drain stops at 3.3 V. Thermistors are board-excited dividers.

g.desc: Seven open-drain stops at 3.3 V. Thermistors are board-excited dividers.

g.text: UART0: cross TX/RX. EN and BOOT pull-ups on board.

g.desc: UART0: cross TX/RX. EN and BOOT pull-ups on board.

g.text: Bridge output: floating speaker pair, neither lead connects to ground. Keep the pair short.

g.desc: Bridge output: floating speaker pair, neither lead connects to ground. Keep the pair short.
